pretreatments.description: Steam pretreatment applied to the whiskey byproducts mixture (WBM). The pretreatment was conducted in an autoclave at 135 °C for 15 min. The pretreatment group without the addition of H_2SO_4 (steam pretreatment) was used to investigate the effect of low pH of thin and thick stillage during the steam heating process.

Sulfuric acid pretreatment applied to the whiskey byproducts mixture (WBM). The dilute H_2SO_4 treated group was used with a final concentration of H_2SO_4 of 2% v/v. The pretreatment was conducted in an autoclave at mild temperatures, though specific time conditions for acid treatment were not explicitly detailed in the provided text for this specific substrate, unlike the steam condition.
